name: Album Roulette
author: Noctis
description: Spin a reel of your album covers and let it pick what to play next. Filter by genre, decade or what you have not played in a while, and get an Album of the Day if you like.

settings.label: Album of the Day
settings.description: Picks one album each day and tells you about it in a short notice.

settings.label: Daily pick hour
settings.description: The hour of the day (0 to 23) the Album of the Day arrives.

settings.label: Leave out compilations
settings.description: Compilations never come up on the reel or as the Album of the Day.

settings.label: Animation
settings.description: Reduced: a short, gentle spin instead of the full reel.
